goal:
T67 — prompt-chain UI on /arena (owner: type at the bottom and watch the result evolve round by round). Web only;
API from T66: POST /v1/arena/{id}/followup {prompt} -> 202 {arena_id}; GET /v1/arena/{id}/chain -> {rounds: [prompt
arena docs with round_index, prompt, status, manifest.acceptance_count, verdict, lanes.{single,evoforge}.{heldout,
preview_html, status}]}.
1. apps/web/lib/arenaStatus.ts (pure):
   - canFollowUp(doc) -> true only for doc.mode === "prompt" and doc.status === "succeeded".
   - promptChainView(chain) -> [] for null/empty, else one row per round sorted by round_index: {round, arenaId,
     prompt, running (true unless status succeeded/failed), unscorable (finished and (winner "unscorable" or
     acceptance_count < 3)), single and evoforge scores "passed/n" (or "—" while running / missing), singlePreview and
     evoforgePreview (that round's preview_html, or null while running), winner (evoforge|single|tie only when finished
     and scorable, else null)}.
2. apps/web/lib/api.ts: postPromptFollowup(arenaId, prompt) and getPromptChain(arenaId).
3. apps/web/components/PromptBar.tsx: when the page shows a finished prompt arena (canFollowUp), the bar offers a
   follow-up ("Next round") sending postPromptFollowup for that arena (placeholder text changes accordingly); keep the
   operator gate + confirm; otherwise it starts a new prompt arena as today.
4. apps/web/app/[locale]/arena/page.tsx: for a prompt arena load its chain and show a round timeline (R1..Rn) above the
   lanes: each round's request, both scores and winner/unscorable/running badges; clicking a round shows that round's
   two SandboxedPreview side by side. Poll the chain while the newest round is running.
5. i18n (en + ko): prompt-followup-placeholder, prompt-followup-start, prompt-chain-title (plus labels you add).
Keep tsc green and every web-structure test green. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t67.py.
